attachments.title: GitHub Actions bot email address?
attachments.text: This is an expected behavior. In commits author field, it will not show the black github-actions bot icon, just a gray one. It shows the name you specify in git config user.name. Github Actions bot is just a bot account when you do operations with GITHUB_TOKEN. In pull requests, issues page, you can see its icon, but not in commits. Sorry for any inconvenience.
